messages:
tess: quick thread: operator vs control-plane ownership for autoscale triggers. we hashed this out but need concrete API names.
nader: operator should expose /admit and /status. control-plane writes PoolPolicy CR with generation. operator reports status with observed_generation.
jules: add a field operator_decision_reason limited to <200 chars for quick ops debugging. not rich logging.
infra-bot: note: sensitive logs should not be returned by /status. see sec-guidelines. :lock:
tess: about forecasting: control-plane publishes forecast_summary {short_p50, short_p95, long_p50}. operator uses short_* to decide immediate prewarm.
nader: lease semantics: operator issues leases when admitting a request. lease includes expires_at and a soft_revocable boolean. control-plane can set preemption_windows to allow safe revocation.
jules: also need a backoff when operator denies because of transient autoscale limits. return Retry-After header.
infra-bot: policy-lint: prefer lease_ttl between 5 and 300s.
tess: ok let's draft the small follow-up RFC. action: nader+jules write a concrete spec; i'll review.
nader: will also add a diagram for control-plane -> operator message flow.
infra-bot: reminder: arch sync Thu 10am.
